close_reason: Already documented: common/mod.rs:852-858 already has the single-lock TOCTOU comment.
description: MemoryBackend::import_email (common/mod.rs:661) acquires one Mutex lock that covers the duplicate Message-ID check, thread assignment, email insert, message_id_index update, and change log bump — all atomically. An earlier version held separate locks for each step, creating a TOCTOU window between duplicate check and insert. The consolidated single-lock design eliminates this window. A contributor might suggest refactoring this into multiple helper calls for readability — resist unless each helper also holds the lock, which would require passing the MutexGuard around.
title: import_email single-lock covers duplicate check + thread assignment + insert — no TOCTOU
